assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code PR-204.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The payer states the service is not covered under the member's benefit plan.
There is a clinical indication note documenting the patient's condition.
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The palpitations and lightheadedness are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia.
Supraventricular tachycardia is coded as I47.1.
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Transient cerebral ischemic attacks are coded as G45.9.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy.
The patient is on current rate-control therapy.
Reconsideration of the coverage determination and payment of the outstanding balance is requested.
